description: Source file implementing tensor factory functions for quantized tensors in PyTorch, including creation of empty quantized tensors with various schemes and options.

methods.name: empty_affine_quantized
methods.description: Creates an empty affine quantized tensor with specified size, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory, scale, zero_point, and optional memory format.

methods.name: empty_per_channel_affine_quantized
methods.description: Creates an empty per-channel affine quantized tensor with specified size, scales, zero_points, axis, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory, and optional memory format.

methods.name: empty_unknown_quantized
methods.description: Creates an empty unknown quantized tensor with specified size, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory, and optional memory format.

methods.name: empty_strided_unknown_quantized
methods.description: Stub function indicating 'not supported' for strided unknown quantized tensors.

methods.name: empty_affine_quantized_other_backends_stub
methods.description: Stub function for unsupported backend-specific affine quantized tensor creation.

methods.name: empty_per_channel_affine_quantized_other_backends_stub
methods.description: Stub function for unsupported backend-specific per-channel affine quantized tensor creation.

methods.name: empty_quantized
methods.description: Creates an empty quantized tensor based on an existing quantized tensor's options and quantization parameters, with support for different qschemes.
